data.block_client: Clients with a network block switch

data_description.block_client: Create a switch that allows you to block and unblock network access for each selected client.
data_description.client_filter_mode: Choose whether Home Assistant creates entities for all clients, only selected clients, or no clients.
data_description.client_source: Clients used when the mode is set to selected. Existing entries for unselected clients are removed after saving.
data_description.create_network_entities: Create all supported entities for UniFi gateways, switches, and access points. When disabled, their existing registry entries are removed automatically.

data_description.ignore_local_mac: Don't create entities for Wi-Fi clients whose MAC is locally administered (e.g. private/randomized Wi-Fi addresses). Wired clients are unaffected. Explicitly selected clients are still included.

adapter_incompatible.title: UniFi selective adapter is incompatible with this Core
adapter_incompatible.description: The built-in UniFi interface changed: {details}. Setup was stopped to preserve client filtering. Update the adapter before retrying.
